_comment: The Playback panel of the ndX plot controls. Replaces the hand-written 'Image' group box, which was a frame selector bolted to image stacks; the same transport now plays any column back, which is what gives burst data a time axis. Rendered by chisurf's AutoForm as a foldable panel.

sections.title: Playback
sections.description: Play the data back along one of its own columns: macro time for bursts, frame index for image stacks.

sections.label: Axis
sections.description: Column the playback runs along. Picked from the data on load — the frame index of an image stack, otherwise the per-burst macro time — but any numeric column can be played back.

sections.label: Steps
sections.description: How many slices the range is cut into. The width of one slice is the range divided by this, so a longer measurement gets wider slices and the playback lasts the same time either way. An index column (frames) starts at one step per value.

sections.label: Step
sections.description: Which slice is on screen. Drag to scrub through the measurement. Hovering shows the slice and how many points survive it.

sections.label: Mode
sections.description: Window: one slice at a time — what the sample looked like then. Integrate: everything up to the current step, accumulating, so a population that only appears late is visible as it arrives. Stack: no gating, the whole measurement at once.

sections.label: Speed
sections.description: Steps per second while playing. A redraw takes a few tens of milliseconds, so above roughly 30 the plot cannot keep up and steps are dropped rather than shown faster.
